source_evidence: Bind actual exception source facts and T-rule to corresponding S/option IDs, values and observed limit. Existing unrelated source locators do not prove a claim.
office_evidence: Locked Office cache-clearing recalculation and source-preserving numeric input overrides; Word native text and separately bound PDF preview. Keep all derived evidence outside frozen candidate workspace.
semantic_judge: Independently inspect all actual artifacts for recommendation reasons, unknown repair/subsidy scope, missing conditions, unsupported actual engineering/approval/payment claims and readability; automation cannot be keyword-only proof.
infrastructure_boundary: Missing private GT/helper/runtime/declared dependency, engine/font drift or grader crash remains evaluation_error; candidate omission/malformed output/business errors lose the relevant checkpoint.
